name: wdpa_iucn_cat_202607
title: Protected Areas (IUCN Categories) - July 2026
description: The World Database on Protected Areas (WDPA) is the most comprehensive global database of marine and terrestrial protected areas. Dataset downloaded July 2026. This is a categorical raster indicating the IUCN category (or relevant information when no category exists) of the protected area covering each pixel.
details: Features which had different IUCN categories and overlapped with each other were assigned a new category (represented by 'mix') during the rasterization process.

processing_options.description: IUCN category (or relevant information when no category exists). Note: provides 12 category columns in total.
